title: Are All Spanish Doctors Male? Evaluating Gender Bias in German Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Translating a German evaluation test set (WinoMTDE) containing sentences with explicitly gendered occupational subjects into seven target languages with grammatical gender. The translated subjects' genders are then extracted using word alignment and morphological analysis to calculate accuracy, gender-based F1-score gaps, and stereotype-based performance gaps based on real-world labor statistics.
